scenes.name: login
scenes.caption: Sign-in screen — cookie-session auth with CSRF double-submit.
scenes.narration: Sign in — your career workspace remembers everything you feed it.

scenes.name: dashboard
scenes.caption: Dashboard — career state at a glance with the docked chat.
scenes.narration: The dashboard shows your top matches, fresh postings and applications — with the assistant always one click away.

scenes.name: catalog
scenes.caption: Job family catalog — the taxonomy tree with AI generation.
scenes.narration: The catalog maps the world of jobs into families and skills — extendable with AI.

scenes.name: rankings
scenes.caption: Matched rankings — fit scores with the compare tray.
scenes.narration: Rankings score every role against your profile — compare the shortlist side by side.

scenes.name: job-detail
scenes.caption: Job insights — fit score, AI explanations, skill gaps and university paths for Data Scientist.
scenes.narration: Open a role and the insights panel explains the fit — strengths, gaps, prerequisites and the paths that close them.

scenes.name: universities
scenes.caption: Universities and pathways — funding, deadlines and degree-to-job routes.
scenes.narration: And when a role needs study first — universities, deadlines and funding, mapped to the job.

scenes.name: profile-experience
scenes.caption: Experience timeline — quantified achievements from the seeded demo persona.
scenes.narration: Your profile holds structured experience — quantified achievements the matching engine can actually read.

scenes.name: cv-studio
scenes.caption: CV Studio — three routes to a CV, versions and exports, with rendered page thumbnails.
scenes.narration: CV Studio builds your CV three ways — from your profile, from an import, or with AI variants.

scenes.name: cv-builder
scenes.caption: CV builder — live preview of a modern sidebar CV (profile, skills and languages in the sidepanel) with version history.
scenes.narration: The builder shows the live page as you edit — modern sidebar template, version history, one-click export.

scenes.name: chat
scenes.caption: Assistant chat — role-fit answer with job reference chips (mock AI on the demo instance).
scenes.narration: Ask which roles fit you — the answer is grounded in your profile and links straight to the roles.

scenes.name: chat-proposals
scenes.caption: HITL proposals — the assistant drafts profile edits as review cards with before/after previews.
scenes.narration: Ask for an edit and nothing happens silently — the change arrives as a review card you approve or reject.

scenes.name: onboarding
scenes.caption: Onboarding wizard — guided or express start paths.
scenes.narration: Onboarding gets you to a useful profile in minutes — guided, or express if you already have a CV.

scenes.name: settings-account
scenes.caption: Settings — account pane of the settings shell.
scenes.narration: And everything stays yours — settings, export and account controls included.
